questions.question: In Atoms in the Family, p. 130 (PDF p. 152), the Nobel Prize had already been announced when Fermi took the arithmetic test. The post calls him a future Nobel laureate. The original wording is retained; propose the 1938 Nobel laureate in English and the corresponding correction in Russian, for editorial approval.

localizations.source: In Atoms in the Family, p. 130 (PDF p. 152), the Nobel Prize had already been announced when Fermi took the arithmetic test. The post calls him a future Nobel laureate. The original wording is retained; propose the 1938 Nobel laureate in English and the corresponding correction in Russian, for editorial approval.
localizations.ru: По Atoms in the Family, стр. 130 (PDF-страница 152), к моменту арифметического теста Нобелевская премия уже была объявлена: Лаура прямо пишет, что даже она не избавила Энрико от проверки. В посте он назван «будущим нобелевским лауреатом». Авторская формулировка сохранена. Предлагается заменить в RU на «лауреат Нобелевской премии 1938 года», в EN — “the 1938 Nobel laureate”; редактору согласовать обе версии.

questions.resolution: The timing is corrected in both versions: the Nobel Prize had already been announced before the consular test.
